privileged_info_for_vlm: The sequence dmd_exon51_region.fasta is approximately 1100-1200 bp long. A search for N(21)GG on both strands should yield approximately 130-150 hits. Valid 23-bp sequences must end in 'GG' if on the direct strand or start with 'CC' if on the complement strand (since the complement of NGG at the 3' end is CCN at the 5' end).
